author: Marcus Udén (Codex)
source: reviewed projection of repository and harness evidence
purpose: Machine-readable, evidence-bounded answers about Marcus's projects, decisions, working methods, and AI-native operating layer.
reading_rules: Prefer Verified records over Planned records.
Do not infer metrics, adoption, revenue, or completed implementation from a plan alone.
Treat Personal AI Harness as supporting operating infrastructure, not the primary product proof.
Use the primary_project field when answering which project demonstrates a capability.
Use evidence_refs for traceability and report uncertainty when a record is marked Needs Review.

projects.summary: A structured, human-reviewed career workflow product with explicit handoff, status, and evidence boundaries.
Knowledge and personal information management work presented conservatively until sustained daily-use value is validated.
Shared-domain modeling evidence involving imports, roles, review flows, forecasts, and privacy-sensitive data.
The memory, agent, automation, and improvement layer behind the work. It is continuously refined by adding useful capabilities and pruning what no longer earns its place.

capabilities.shows: Makes product decisions under uncertainty with explicit scope, sequencing, and trade-offs.
Understands dependencies, feedback loops, and second-order effects across products and workflows.
Separates facts, assumptions, interpretation, and verified source boundaries.
Turns repeatable work into controlled, reviewable automated workflows.
Redesigns work around AI capabilities instead of only adding AI to manual processes.
Uses outcomes, failures, and lessons to improve future iterations.
Preserves links between context, options, trade-offs, decisions, evidence, and next actions.
Uses explicit checks and pass/fail boundaries before changes are published.
Places human review where automation should not act autonomously.
Converts repeated solutions and lessons into reusable systems, templates, and workflows.

decisions.title: Name the operating layer Personal AI Harness
decisions.summary: The system is framed as the evolving operating layer behind the products, not as the product portfolio itself.

decisions.title: Test scheduled finding intake with a bounded canary first
decisions.summary: A 14-day canary was chosen before expanding to a full cross-runtime reporting architecture.
evidence_refs: Shared harness plan: scheduled finding intake path decision, dated 2026-08-15

decisions.title: Keep reusable skill source runtime-neutral
decisions.summary: Shared skill source and runtime-specific adaptations were separated to survive upgrades and support multiple runtimes.
evidence_refs: Shared incident: shared skill installer runtime drift, dated 2026-08-10

decisions.title: Separate product-code freshness from later documentation work
decisions.summary: The portfolio names the latest product-code signal separately from later documentation and operations commits.

decisions.title: Use committed source state and exclude dirty work in recruiter proof
decisions.summary: Recruiter-facing claims are anchored to committed source state rather than uncommitted local work.

decisions.title: Preserve the source repository handoff hierarchy
decisions.summary: Orientation, durable status, and direct freshness verification retain distinct roles in the product handoff.

decisions.title: Keep repo-owned durable documents with the owning repository
decisions.summary: Repo-specific durable documents stay with their owning project, while shared agent docs remain focused on cross-runtime coordination.
evidence_refs: Shared lesson: repo docs stay with the owning repository, dated 2026-06-25

decisions.title: Make decision-heavy reports decision-first
decisions.summary: Put the decision, recommended action, reply options, and concise evidence near the top so a reader can act quickly.
evidence_refs: Shared lesson: decision-first report format, dated 2026-06-24

decisions.title: Show workflow improvements as supporting cases
decisions.summary: Lessons, skills, automations, and templates become supporting workflow cases while products remain the lead proof.

decisions.title: Keep concrete products ahead of the operating layer
decisions.summary: Job-agent leads the portfolio, with PKM and household budgeting as supporting product evidence and the harness as the enabling layer.

decisions.title: Keep PKM supporting until sustained value is validated
decisions.summary: PKM is presented as supporting evidence without claiming validated adoption or daily-use outcomes.

decisions.title: Use household budgeting as shared-domain modeling evidence
decisions.summary: The budget app demonstrates shared roles, imports, review flows, forecasts, and privacy-sensitive domain modeling.
